description: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. The listing groups 18 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Grafo viario de las calles de la ciudad de Barcelona; Calles pacificadas de la ciudad de Barcelona; Rotulación de calles y espacios públicos de la ciudad de Barcelona; Calles con plataforma única sin vehículos motorizados en la ciudad de . Formats seen: ZIP, CSV, JSON, SHP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
